notes.title: Update # 12 - Blood Sins
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/9aedca1605fe9230aae6a6dd2163414426cee565.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🌡️ Patch Notes – Status Effects & Desert Improvements[/h2][h3]💥 New Status Effects[/h3][list][*][p][b]Hot temperature[/b] and [b]cold temperature[/b] effects added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bleed[/b] and [b]extreme bleed[/b] status effects are now in the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slow movement[/b] status effect implemented.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧰 Combat & Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]A new [b]custom weapon[/b] for the [b]Masked Man[/b] applies [i]extreme bleed[/i] to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]heal normal bleeding[/b] using the rag.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will [b]automatically heal when returning to spawn[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]🌵 Desert Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]hot temperature zone[/b] to the desert biome.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Water sources[/b] added in the desert to prevent overheating.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]drink water[/b] to stay hydrated.[/p][/*][/list][h3]📘 Tutorials & Feedback[/h3][list][*][p]New tutorial tip: [i]"Remember to switch between melee and ranged if needed."[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New tutorial tip: [i]"If you feel lost, remember to check your map."[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]🔊 Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]rockfall sound effects[/b] to the [b]Goron arena[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/1856abfb0b8da6a9f7f4af184231c6025ae37002.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🔊 Patch Notes – Audio & Sounds Update[/h2][h3]🎧 Sound Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Sorted and cleaned up [b]project audio assets[/b] for better organization.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🗣️ New Sound Implementations[/h3][list][*][p]Added sounds for:[/p][list][*][p][b]Spiders[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ravager[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Amrak[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hope[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update # 10 - Blood Sins
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/d4acbdaa66dc8e85cc71052ca6263eb7ba17895d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]📦 Patch Notes – Scriptable Object & Balance Changes[/h2][h3]🧟 Enemy & Boss Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Updated [b]names for all enemies[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]health and damage values[/b] for both [b]bosses[/b] and [b]standard enemies[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]📈 Progression & Economy[/h3][list][*][p]Revised the [b]game’s overall progression curve[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item values[/b] have been rebalanced across the board for better economy flow.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧾 Descriptions & Metadata[/h3][list][*][p]Added a proper [b]description to the Ravager scale[/b] item for clarity.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update # 9 - Blood Sins
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/11892652266650160257d89942865f8489961723.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🧪 Patch Notes – Demo Integration & Item Upgrade Fixes[/h2][h3]🧩 Content Integration[/h3][list][*][p][b]Door icons[/b] from the demo have been added to the full game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Easter egg items[/b] from the demo are now available in the full game.[/p][/*][*][p]All demo items were reviewed and applied to the [b]full game item pool[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Item Upgrade System[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]item upgrades were wiped[/b] when equipping them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]upgrade effects weren’t applying[/b] as expected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade costs[/b] now depend on the [b]item’s value[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trading now considers upgraded item value[/b] when calculating trade worth.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update # 8 - Blood Sins
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/5ff58ed230d548bf03c209c1f22d593ea60e7d12.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🎚️ Patch Notes – Audio & Settings Update[/h2][h3]🔊 Audio Options Overhaul[/h3][list][*][p]The old volume slider is now labeled [b]"General Volume"[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added new individual sliders for:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ambience Volume[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Music Volume[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Effects Volume[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Voice Volume[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🎮 Control Settings[/h3][list][*][p][b]Sensitivity slider[/b] now allows a [b]lower minimum value[/b] for finer control.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update # 7 - Blood Sins
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/cfc179efe63bc68e209b61be615dd26467e778f7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]It’s been a little while since the last update—I’ve just wrapped up a very busy month, topped off by something incredible: my son was born a few days ago! 👶💙[/p][p]I’m excited to get back into the swing of things and will be resuming regular updates for the game.[/p][p]Also, a huge thank you to [b]Frecuencia Gamer[/b] and the [b]QA Team[/b] who have been actively testing the game and hunting down bugs. Your support means the world—especially as a solo dev, this kind of help makes a massive difference.[/p][p]Thanks so much for your continued support and patience![/p][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Patch Notes – UI, Bug Fixes & Scene Logic[/h2][h3]🔍 Exploration & UI[/h3][list][*][p][b]Increased exploration ray[/b], allowing better detection of explored map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Safezone towers[/b] made slightly larger so players can now climb them properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Use" text and interaction targets[/b] are now hidden during dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minimap toggle[/b] is now disabled while the game is paused or during dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]message prompt to skip cinematics[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]UI improvements and internal project cleanup[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧱 Environment & Scene Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused players to get [b]stuck on towers[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]invisible wall issues[/b] in both the [b]Goron arena[/b] and [b]Safezone[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]pause validation during scene transitions[/b] to prevent glitches.[/p][/*][/list][h3]💬 Dialogue & Narrative[/h3][list][*][p][b]Rem is now deactivated[/b] correctly when forgiven by the player and exits the arena.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]"use" prompt[/b] no longer appears when chests are open.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧾 Polish & Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]inconsistencies in translations[/b] on the player death panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled [b]unnecessary data[/b] on the death panel for a cleaner UI.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update # 4 – Blood Sins
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/4bb407a8eca8212cdcbb4bd1cd782638ea346927.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔊 Audio & Interface[/h3][list][*][p]You can now [b]adjust voice volume[/b] using the volume slider.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]music stops[/b] correctly when defeated by the Ravager.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer [b]pause or open the inventory during dialogues[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Visuals & Level Design[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]missing item sprites and stat displays[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced [b]bloom intensity[/b] in overly bright levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Invisible walls[/b] added in several areas to prevent unintended access.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🏆 Achievements[/h3][list][*][p]Added several [b]new achievements[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements are now [b]properly unlockable[/b] in-game.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🗺️ UI & Controls[/h3][list][*][p][b]M key to open the map[/b] is now working again.
[i](This fix was previously missed, but it’s now finally applied.)[/i][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update # 3 – Blood Sins
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/483188c0acee1b4ce377a0efb71408a37bef5586.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay & Progression[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Game+[/b] improvements: Ravager scale no longer carries over from the player container.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could fight a phase boss without completing the dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the [b]minimum number of rooms[/b] per phase for a more challenging experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rem[/b] no longer gets stuck on the circular platform.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sith[/b] no longer skips the jump protection when dying.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🗺️ UI & Controls[/b][/p][list][*][p]Finished full [b]controller support[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p][b]🗣️ Dialogue & NPCs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made all [b]dialogues faster[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogues now stop correctly when leaving after Phase 3.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial dialogues[/b] added to safe zone guards.[/p][/*][*][p]Guards in the [b]safe zone[/b] were replaced with updated versions.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Day One Patch – Blood Sins
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811161/4c96085c376172d121f160b83fe1eeb8d1b37c55.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who jumped into the game! Here’s what we’ve fixed in this first patch based on your reports and internal tests:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]⚔️[b] Boss & Gameplay Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bosses now properly resist damage and effects at the start of encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rem would jump and then snap back to the starting point.[/p][/*][*][p]Rem is now immune to sound and damage right before roaring.[/p][/*][*][p]You no longer lose 100 gold when upgrading without selecting an item.[/p][/*][*][p]The spear was removed from the possible drops since is not ready yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could beat the boss “Hope” twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs with Hope’s invisibility and expedition quest not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Ravager not appearing due to conflicts with the Hope bossfight.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🎮[b] Controls & UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Exiting the game using [b]Y[/b] or [b]Triangle[/b] no longer freezes the game.[/p][/*][*][p]“M” key now opens the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support:[/p][list][*][p]You can now open item info panels with the controller.[/p][/*][*][p]The death screen now responds to the controller.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now delete items using a controller.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🛠️[b] Systems & Menus[/b][/p][list][*][p]Save game info now correctly displays on the load screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Exploration percentage now updates correctly on the volcano.[/p][/*][*][p]Map items now set exploration to 100% as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]The sensitivity slider now applies changes immediately without needing to adjust other settings.[/p][/*][*][p]The idle sound from the portal now stops as it should.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled mana regeneration.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled base health regeneration.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🧭[b] Game World & Progression[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed gaps in Phase 9 that could trap players between rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]If you get knocked out in the Valhar arena, you now correctly return to the safe zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could activate the final portal by defeating only one of the two bosses (Sith and Arthaz).[/p][/*][*][p]Selling items now works as individual units, not bundles.[/p][/*][/list]
